item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 29/Aug/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Showers and thunderstorms associated with an upper-air disturbance will affect southern China today. With the upper-air disturbance departing, showers will lessen tomorrow. A broad trough of low pressure will bring showers to the central and northern parts of the South China Sea during the weekend to early next week. Meanwhile, an anticyclone aloft will strengthen gradually and bring very hot weather to southeastern China. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Shanshan will move across Kyushu of Japan today. It will then move towards the vicinity of Shikoku of Japan and then linger over the region.
